description: This file defines the ModelMenu class, which models the <menu> XML element within the OFBIZ widget framework. It parses XML attributes, constructs a read-only, immutable data structure representing a menu, manages menu items and actions, and provides methods for rendering the menu as a string via different renderers.

classes.name: ModelMenu
classes.description: Represents a read-only, immutable model of the <menu> XML element within the OFBIZ widget framework, capable of parsing XML attributes, managing menu items/actions, and rendering the menu.

methods.description: Accepts a ModelWidgetVisitor to process this ModelMenu object.
